title: Most frequent value with a numeric tie break
statement: Return Mode(value, count) for the most frequent input value. Break frequency ties by choosing the numerically smallest value. For empty input return value=0 and count=0.
constraints: values has at most 100 entries, each in [-1000, 1000]
Inputs obey the stated domain; do not mutate caller-owned inputs.
The required return value fits signed 64-bit integers; choose arithmetic that keeps intermediate values within that range. TypeScript uses bigint for integer values.
Do not perform input/output, throw, panic, add tests, or suppress static diagnostics.

struct Mode:
    value: int64
    count: int64

function histogram_mode(values: list[int64]) returns Mode
